token.description: The full token. Shown once, never again.

ApiKeyUpdate.title: ApiKeyUpdate

config.description: Plain configuration; never holds a secret
config.title: Config

ProviderTest.description: Unsaved form values; for a stored instance merged over what is stored.
ProviderTest.title: ProviderTest

config_schema.description: JSON schema of the configuration; secret fields carry "x-secret": true
config_schema.title: Config Schema

ProviderUpdate.description: Fields left out stay as they are; ``config`` is merged field by field.
ProviderUpdate.title: ProviderUpdate

csrf_token.description: Send in X-BambuBridge-CSRF with every state-changing request
csrf_token.title: Csrf Token

identity_provider.description: Provider that opened the session; null for a token sign-in
identity_provider.title: Identity Provider

identity_subject.description: Subject the identity provider reported; null for a token sign-in
identity_subject.title: Identity Subject

user.description: Display name of the signed-in user
user.title: User

default.description: Default value; always null for secrets
default.title: Default

set.description: A value is stored (otherwise the default applies)
set.title: Set

undecryptable.description: A stored secret cannot be decrypted
undecryptable.title: Undecryptable

value.description: Effective value; always null for secrets
value.title: Value

SettingsUpdate.description: ``null`` resets a setting to its default; ``null`` or ``""`` clears a secret.
SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate

SignInRequest.title: SignInRequest

BambuBridgeBootstrap.name: X-BambuBridge-Bootstrap

BambuBridgeKey.description: API token (bb_pat_...). The required scope is listed per operation.
BambuBridgeKey.name: X-BambuBridge-Key

get.description: Metadata of all tokens; the token itself and its hash are never included.

schema.title: Response List Api Keys Api V1 Admin Api Keys Get

post.description: Create a token. The response's ``token`` is the only time the plaintext is shown.

delete.description: Delete a token; it is rejected from the next request on.

patch.description: Change name, note, enabled or expiry. Scope and token value cannot change.

delete.description: Revoke the current browser session and clear its cookies.

get.description: The caller's own sign-in: a session (with its CSRF token) or the API token.

post.description: Opens a browser session and sets the session and CSRF cookies. With a body ``{token}`` the API token is checked; without a body the active identity providers are asked (trusted SSO headers). Needs an ``Origin`` of the public URL; rate limited per client address.
post.summary: Sign in to the web UI

get.summary: Name, version and build of this server

post.summary: Test unsaved values of a new instance

schema.title: Response List Providers Api V1 Providers Get

Test a stored instance, optionally with unsaved values

401.description: Not signed in; a browser navigation gets a page that moves on to the sign-in (text/html)

429.description: Too many sign-in attempts; a browser navigation gets a page that moves on to the sign-in once Retry-After has passed (text/html)

get.summary: Continue to the web UI after sign-in

get.description: Report that the process is up. No auth, no version, no dependencies.
